lessons.title: Synthesis across sources
lessons.learn: Control synthesis across sources in sustained professional, academic, and public discourse.

grammar.title: Synthesis across sources
grammar.explain: Bengali uses case markers and postpositions, non-finite conjunctive and conditional forms, relative-correlative constructions, evidential নাকি/মনে হয়, classifiers, honorific agreement, topic/focus particles and সাধু–চলিত/formal register choices.
